notes: Farmer Brown is the most recognisable cover character alongside the cows, but cows and duck are already in existing activity_images so they serve well as fringe. The word 'angry' is included because Farmer Brown's emotional response (frustration/anger) is central to the story and is picturable and communicatively useful for students retelling or responding to the story. 'Strike' is noted in aac_extras and could supplement the board as an extension word. 'Typewriter' exists in activity_images and is the single most iconic object in the book. 'Blanket' captures the animals' demand — the core conflict — making it high priority fringe vocabulary.
